dct_creator_sm: Jørgensen, Bo Nørregaard (University of Southern Denmark). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5678-6602
dct_description_sm:
This repository contains data and models associated with the article:
"Best combinations of energy-efficiency measures in greenhouses considering energy consumption, yield, and costs: Comparison between two cold climate cities"
Published in Applied Energy. DOI: 10.1016/j.apenergy.2024.125163.

The study compares energy-efficiency measures in greenhouses across two cold-climate cities: Montreal (MTL) and Copenhagen (CPH). The results include energy consumption, yield, and cost analyses for various scenarios.

A Readme file provides all the explanations as to how to use this dataset.
dct_title_s: Models and results of simulations for 31 energy efficiency measures in Montreal (Canada) and Copenhagen (Denmark)
